enforcement.before: No predecessor is declared for the initial distribution.
enforcement.after: The initial controller, registration and adapter contracts define current installation behavior.
enforcement.rationale: Initial installation, independent authorization and real native consent remain required; no historical controller transition is claimed.
enforcement.already_satisfied: Owned adapter readers accept the current interface and actual administrative receipts remain valid; SHA/status alone is insufficient.
enforcement.recovery: Inspect actual active configuration and journal phase under an exclusive owned lock; preserve verified active on staging failure; reconcile activated_pending_checkpoint before advancement. Never remove ongoing/recovery code or advance peer adoption.
enforcement.retention: one active plus at most one ordinary transient candidate; no historical snapshots
enforcement.target_commit: Resolve containing OOP Git commit after publication; never a future self-SHA.

current.state_schema: Initial OOP contract: action receipts, revision-bound agent assessments, controller-observed local facts, scoped bookkeeping, deterministic response framing and progress-bound completion.
current.read_compatibility: Verify per-domain actual state under existing canonical policy.
current.write_compatibility: Writes require the current adapter readers and current session-state schema; other writers block dependent effects.
current.existing_state_policy: Preserve valid records; unknown or incompatible domains block dependent work.

support_evidence: Reviewed initial source distribution and independently owned state contracts; no release predecessor or migration effects are asserted.
unsupported: Any other observed state is unsupported: retain verified adoption facts, block dependent unsafe work and perform a fresh runtime bootstrap preserving organizational data, private secrets and peer state.
